title: Senior Structural Welding Engineer (IWE/EWE)
summary: We are seeking a certified International/European Welding Engineer (IWE/EWE) to oversee welding procedure qualifications (WPS/PQR), automated tandem submerged-arc welding lines, and non-destructive examination (NDE) quality protocols for heavy bridge and industrial infrastructure projects.
responsibilities: Develop, qualify, and maintain Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS) and Procedure Qualification Records (PQR) in accordance with EN 1090-2 (EXC3) and AWS D1.1.
Lead and supervise automated tandem submerged-arc welding (SAW) columns and robotic welding cells.
Review radiographic (RT), ultrasonic (UT), magnetic particle (MT), and liquid penetrant (PT) inspection results.
Train, mentor, and qualify production welders in conformance with ISO 9606-1 qualification standards.
Collaborate directly with third-party client inspection agencies (TÜV, Bureau Veritas, Lloyd's Register).
qualifications: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Metallurgical, Materials, or Mechanical Engineering from an accredited university.
Certified International Welding Engineer (IWE) or European Welding Engineer (EWE) diploma.
Minimum 7 years of hands-on structural steel fabrication or heavy industrial manufacturing experience.
Expert proficiency in EN 1090-2, AWS D1.1, and ISO 3834-2 standards.
Strong command of professional English and Amharic technical terminology.
benefits: Competitive executive compensation package benchmarked against international engineering standards.
Comprehensive family health insurance and medical coverage.
Annual professional continuous development, international conference attendance, and certification funding.
Company transport, modern tooling, and safety equipment provision.

title: Lead Automation & Robotics Controls Engineer
summary: Lead the electrical, PLC, and robotic integration teams responsible for commissioning automated conveyor systems, CNC fiber laser cutting cells, and industrial machinery assembly lines.
responsibilities: Program, configure, and commission Siemens S7-1500, Allen-Bradley ControlLogix, and Beckhoff PLC architectures.
Design electrical schematics and control panels in EPLAN conforming to IEC 60204-1 safety standards.
Integrate 6-axis industrial robot arms for automated welding and heavy material manipulation.
Direct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) for client turnkey deliveries.
qualifications: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical, Mechatronics, or Automation Engineering.
8+ years of industrial automation and PLC programming experience in heavy manufacturing environments.
Demonstrated track record with industrial communication protocols (PROFINET, EtherCAT, Modbus TCP).
Certified functional safety engineer (TÜV Rheinland FS Eng) preferred.
benefits: Industry-leading salary and performance-based project milestone bonuses.
Subsidized housing allowance and executive transport.
High-impact role leading national manufacturing automation.

title: Materials & Metallurgical Quality Scientist
summary: Manage Asterra's ISO 17025 accredited materials testing laboratory, conducting chemical spectrometry, tensile mechanical testing, Charpy impact toughness testing, and microscopic grain analysis.
responsibilities: Operate optical emission spectrometers (OES) for carbon and alloy steel chemical analysis.
Conduct universal tensile testing (up to 1,000 kN) and Charpy V-notch impact testing at sub-zero temperatures.
Perform microstructural metallurgical grain analysis and hardness mapping across weld cross-sections.
Issue 3.1 and 3.2 Material Test Certificates in accordance with EN 10204.
qualifications: M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Metallurgy, Materials Science, or Applied Chemistry.
5+ years of certified metallurgical testing laboratory experience.
Familiarity with ISO 17025 lab quality accreditation procedures.

title: Director of Occupational Health, Safety & ESG
location: Addis Ababa (Group-wide travel across all 4 plants)
summary: Direct group-wide health, safety, environmental, and corporate sustainability systems across Asterra's four manufacturing plants, leading our continuous zero-harm workplace agenda.
responsibilities: Lead governance and recertification for ISO 45001 (Health & Safety) and ISO 14001 (Environmental Management).
Oversee plant-wide environmental monitoring, solar energy integration, and closed-loop scrap recycling.
Direct group safety training academies and manage third-party statutory safety audits.
qualifications: Master's Degree in Occupational Safety, Environmental Engineering, or related field.
NEBOSH National Diploma or Certified Safety Professional (CSP).
10+ years of senior safety leadership in heavy industrial or manufacturing plants.
benefits: Board-level strategic reporting and leadership development.
